column1: 30601§chronological§ˌkrɒnəˈlɒdʒɪkl§adj. 按时间顺序的；依年代先后排列的§However, it relates Edison's life in reverse chronological order, an unusual approach about which reviewer Derek Thompson said, "Nothing is gained by [it], and much comprehension is lost. "§然而，这本书以**倒序**的方式讲述爱迪生的生平，这一不寻常的处理让评论者 Derek Thompson 说：「这样做一无所获，反倒让人失去很多理解。」§Shurin’s volume is chronologically expansive, featuring such stories as Samuel R.§Shurin 的选集**时间跨度**极广，收录了 Samuel R. Delany 等人的作品。§chrono- 时间 + logical 学科的 → chronological；副词 chronologically§reverse chronological order 倒序（按时间由近及远）§§

30602§bureaucratic§ˌbjʊərəˈkrætɪk§adj. 官僚的；行政机构的；官僚作风的§… advocates of developmental-state theory hold that the formal enforcement of meritocratic hiring and other bureaucratic initiatives enable growth.§发展型国家理论的拥护者主张，正式推行择优录用以及其他**行政**举措，能够促成经济增长。§§§bureau 局 + -cracy 统治 → bureaucracy → bureaucratic§bureaucratic initiatives 行政举措§常含贬义，指「繁文缛节、官僚作风」§改译文：原译「对公职人员个人敛财的法律约束」与英文 formal enforcement of meritocratic hiring（正式推行择优录用）不符

30603§profile§ˈprəʊfaɪl§n. （成分）谱；特征数据；（土壤、沉积物的）剖面；概况；轮廓 v. 概述；扼要描述§By contrast, bison dung cannot be distinguished from elk dung based solely on their fecal-steroidal profiles, as both contain similar levels of beta-sitosterol and cholestanone, among other sterols.§相比之下，仅凭粪便**甾醇谱**无法区分野牛粪与麋鹿粪，因为两者都含有相近水平的 β-谷甾醇与胆甾烷酮等甾醇。§To explain the finding, they noted that many of the included studies didn't specify whether the reported soil profiles were those of the rhizosphere.§为解释这一发现，他们指出：纳入的许多研究并未说明所报告的土壤**剖面**是否属于根际。§§fecal-steroidal profiles 粪便甾醇谱；soil profiles 土壤剖面；high-profile adj. 高调的；受瞩目的（high-profile offenders 显要的违规者）§§

30604§irrespective§ˌɪrɪˈspektɪv§adj. 不考虑的；不顾的（irrespective of 不论；与…无关）§Some ethicists hold that the moral goodness of an individual's actions depends solely on whether the actions themselves are good, irrespective of the context in which they are carried out.§一些伦理学家认为，一个人行为的道德善恶只取决于行为本身是否良善，而与行为发生的具体情境**无关**。§§§§irrespective of 不论；与…无关§比 regardless 更正式；后必须接 of，不能单独使用§

30605§coarse§kɔːs§adj. 粗糙的；（质地）粗的；粗略的；粗俗的§Domestic sheep’s wild ancestor, the mouflon, has a coarse outer coat and an inner coat of wool fiber that is finer in diameter and therefore much softer.§家羊的野生祖先欧洲盘羊，长有一层**粗硬**的外层毛，以及一层纤维直径更细、因而柔软得多的内层绒毛。§The researchers concluded that variations in the landscape affect net CO₂, in ways that most models are too coarse to capture.§研究者得出结论：地形变化会影响净二氧化碳通量，而多数模型过于**粗放**，难以捕捉这些影响。§§a coarse outer coat 粗硬的外层毛；coarse language 粗话§与 course（课程）同音易混§

30606§ripple§ˈrɪpl§n. 涟漪；波纹；（水流塑成的）沙纹 v. 泛起波纹；（影响）扩散§Sazanami (Ripples) is an important work of Nihonga, or classical Japanese painting.§《Sazanami》（《**涟漪**》）是日本画（Nihonga，即古典日本绘画）的重要作品。§Ripples form in two main ways: from waves or from currents.§**波纹**主要有两种成因：波浪或水流。§§ripple effect 连锁反应§§改例句：Sazami 拼错，应为 Sazanami（福田平八郎名作《漣》），译文同改

30607§contemplate§ˈkɒntəmpleɪt§v. 沉思；凝视；仔细考虑；盘算；打算§Like many other simple‑hearted souls, it was her pet vanity to believe she was endowed with a talent for dark and mysterious diplomacy, and she loved to contemplate her most transparent devices as marvels of low cunning.§像许多心地单纯的人一样，她有一份得意的虚荣：相信自己天生擅长隐秘而深沉的权谋，还喜欢把自己那些一眼就能看穿的手段，当作精妙狡计的杰作来**反复玩味**。§Architects dedicated to this approach carefully contemplate every aspect of their projects from location characteristics and initial materials selection to ultimate interior design choices and building installation.§奉行这一理念的建筑师会仔细**推敲**项目的方方面面——从选址特点与最初的材料选择，到最终的室内设计决策与建筑安装。§§contemplation n. 沉思§比 think about 更带「凝神静观」的意味§

30608§populous§ˈpɒpjələs§adj. 人口众多的；人口稠密的§As the second-most populous continent in the world, Africa was home to an estimated 1.186 billion people in 2015.§作为世界**人口第二多**的大洲，非洲在 2015 年约有 11.86 亿人口。§In a US national election, one might expect major-party campaigns to focus on the most populous states.§在美国全国大选中，人们或许以为两大党的竞选会把火力集中在**人口最多**的州。§popul- 人民 → populous§the second-most populous continent 人口第二多的大洲§与 popular（受欢迎的）区分§

30609§commonplace§ˈkɒmənpleɪs§adj. 平凡的；司空见惯的 n. 老生常谈；常见的事§… as its rootedness in commonplace craft traditions gives it an authenticity and accessibility that fine art …§……因为它根植于**寻常**的工艺传统，这赋予了它一种纯艺术……的本真性与亲近感……§§§§commonplace craft traditions 寻常的工艺传统§与 extraordinary（非凡的）相对§改译文：英文只是片段，原译把整段（民艺与纯艺术的区别、纯艺术推崇精致与创新）都译了，删去英文没有的部分

30610§inverse§ˌɪnˈvɜːs§adj. 相反的；反向的；（关系）反比的§Biologist Ari Martinez and colleagues, who studied the ecological community the species share, hypothesized that there is an inverse relationship between birds' field of vision while foraging and their sensitivity to alarm calls from neighboring species.§生物学家 Ari Martinez 及同事研究了这些物种共享的生态群落，并假设鸟在觅食时的视野范围与其对邻近物种警报声的敏感度之间存在**反比**关系。§§§invert 倒转 → inverse§an inverse relationship 反比关系；in inverse proportion to 与…成反比§§改例句：forageing 拼错，应为 foraging

30611§solitude§ˈsɒlɪtjuːd§n. 独处；孤独；幽静§It is associated with Gabriel García Márquez, whose One Hundred Years of Solitude is a key text.§它与加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯相关联，其《百年**孤独**》是这一脉络的关键文本。§Scholars cite One Hundred Years of Solitude, the 1967 novel by Colombian author Gabriel Garcia Marquez, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the spiritual and narrative traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.§学者们把哥伦比亚作家加西亚·马尔克斯 1967 年的《百年**孤独**》奉为魔幻现实主义的奠基之作——这一拉美小说风格在原本属于现代小说的现实主义叙事框架中，部署反现实的情节设计（常借自美洲原住民与殖民社会的灵性及叙事传统）。§§One Hundred Years of Solitude 《百年孤独》§中性或褒义，指主动选择的清静；与 loneliness（孤独寂寞）不同§

30612§ballad§ˈbæləd§n. 民谣；叙事歌谣；（慢板）情歌§Dolly Parton, who was born and raised in the region, was deeply influenced by these traditional ballads, as can be heard in the songs she wrote in the first decade of her career.§多莉·帕顿出生并成长于该地区，深受这些传统**歌谣**影响——这一点在她职业生涯头十年所写的歌里可以听出来。§The influence of the ballads of this region can be heard in the word choice and subject matter of the lyrics to “Jolene,” one of her best songs from this period.§该地区**民谣**的影响可从她这一时期最好的歌曲之一《Jolene》歌词的遣词与题材中听出。§§traditional ballads 传统歌谣§与 lyric（抒情诗）相对：ballad 重叙事；音乐语境指慢板情歌§

30613§orient§ˈɔːrient§v. 使朝向；使定向；使适应；使熟悉（环境）§University of California, Berkeley biologist Ciera Martinez and colleagues examined several species of grapevines and closely related plants, which have leaves that grow in pairs, to see if both leaves in a pair tend to be oriented toward the same side (that is, have more tissue on the same side) or not.§加州大学伯克利分校生物学家 Ciera Martinez 及同事考察了数个葡萄属物种及近缘植物——它们的叶片成对生长——以弄清一对叶片是否倾向于**朝向**同一侧（即在同侧有更多组织）。§The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as abjuk, a present-oriented expression that translates to “now," and coded each speaker's manual gestures.§研究者录下雅普诺语使用者解释特定时间词语（如**面向**当下的 abjuk，可译作「现在」）的过程，并对每位说话者的手势进行编码。§§be oriented toward 朝向；orient oneself 使自己适应（熟悉环境）；present-oriented 面向当下的；orientation n. 方向；定位§§改例句：that is. 应为 that is,

30614§repository§rɪˈpɒzətri§n. 储存库；仓库；（知识、信息的）宝库；资料库§Indigenous songs can be repositories of ecological information, from Yi songs about the natural environment to Tlingit songs about wildlife encounters.§原住民歌曲可以是生态信息的**储存库**——从彝族关于自然环境的歌，到特林吉特人关于与野生动物相遇的歌。§§§§repositories of ecological information 生态信息的储存库§引申指「知识库、资料库」，也可指可信赖的资料来源§原书错：义项写「同根 repository 亦指……」，把本词当成自己的同根词

30615§discreet§dɪˈskriːt§adj. 谨慎的；言行有分寸的；不张扬的§… and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow.§在同僚教士眼中，他是个**谨慎**而随和的人。§§§§a discreet and agreeable fellow 谨慎而随和的人§与 discrete（离散的、分开的）拼写近、意义完全不同，SAT 常考§

30616§repertoire§ˈrepətwɑː§n. （全部）剧目；曲目；（某人的）全部技能、手段§But according to professor James Wade, even more unusually, the three texts in the manuscript’s first booklet were likely copied by Richard Heege from a traveling minstrel’s repertoire book.§但据 James Wade 教授说，更为不寻常的是，手稿第一个小册子里的三篇文本很可能是 Richard Heege 从一位流动吟游艺人的**曲目**本上抄录的。§Recently, however, James Wade has argued that a manuscript collection compiled in the fifteenth century by Richard Heege contains three pieces likely copied from a repertoire book belonging to a minstrel working in the area around Heege’s home.§然而 James Wade 近年主张：Richard Heege 在十五世纪汇编的一部抄本中，含有三件很可能抄自某位游吟艺人**曲目**簿的作品——该艺人活跃于 Heege 家乡附近。§§repertoire book 曲目本§§

30617§enact§ɪˈnækt§v. 制定（法律）；颁布；扮演；上演§But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in enacting the Clean Air Act into law, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.§但尼克松的政治遗产是复杂的：人们称赞他把《清洁空气法》**签署成法**，他还曾尝试改革美国医疗保障政策，这可以说是《平价医疗法案》的前身——后者在奥巴马执政期间成为法律。§In 2004, the US state of North Dakota enacted rate stability regulations (RSRs), constraining insurance companies’ latitude to raise premiums (the periodic fees policyholders pay to maintain insurance policies) after policies are in effect.§2004 年，美国北达科他州**颁布**了费率稳定条款（RSR），限制保险公司在保单生效后上调保费（投保人为维持保单定期缴纳的费用）的自由度。§§enact sth into law 使…成为法律；enact a role 扮演角色；enactment n. 颁布§§

30618§deterioration§dɪˌtɪəriəˈreɪʃn§n. 恶化；变质；劣化；退化§After five months in Earth air at 30%‑40% humidity (lower‑than‑average humidity for most nondesert Earth locations), a small sample of Leto material showed significant evaporite deterioration and new compound formation; after eight months in similar conditions, another sample experienced complete loss of sodium evaporites.§在地球空气中以 30%–40% 的湿度（对地球多数非沙漠地区而言属偏低湿度）放置五个月后，一小份 Leto 材料样本出现明显的蒸发盐**劣化**与新生化合物；在类似条件下放置八个月后，另一份样本的钠蒸发盐则完全流失。§Their measurements and observations revealed that quality of conditions during the concrete curing phase negatively correlates with gas permeability and that high gas permeability values are associated with increased deterioration as concrete surfaces age.§他们的测量与观察显示：混凝土养护阶段的条件质量与气体渗透率呈负相关，而高气体渗透率伴随混凝土表面老化加剧的**劣化**。§deteriorate 恶化 → deterioration§evaporite deterioration 蒸发盐劣化§比 damage 更强调渐进过程§

30619§inadvertently§ˌɪnədˈvɜːtəntli§adv. 无意中；不经意地；因疏忽§However, in a response paper, Jeff Ollerton et al. note that Rosas-Guerrero et al. may have inadvertently excluded studies published before the term “pollinator effectiveness” came into common use.§然而，Jeff Ollerton 等人在一篇回应文章中指出，Rosas-Guerrero 等人可能**无意中**排除了在「传粉者效能」这一术语通行之前发表的研究。§Those studying the works of William Ellery Channing, for instance, may inadvertently overlook nuances in his work by focusing only on the most obvious ways in which his style corresponds to transcendentalism.§例如，研究 William Ellery Channing 的学者若只关注其风格与超验主义最明显的对应，就可能**无意间**忽略作品中的细微之处。§in- 否定 + advertent 留意的 → inadvertently；形容词 inadvertent§may have inadvertently excluded 可能无意中排除了§§

30620§invariably§ɪnˈveəriəbli§adv. 总是；一贯地；无一例外地§Olivia Rutigliano and other scholars cite a lack of nuance and erasure of intention in the implication that pseudonymous identities were invariably necessary due to social roles, appropriately contending that what may have been a constraint for some was an elective exercise in self-fashioning for others.§Olivia Rutigliano 等学者指出，那种认为笔名身份因社会角色而**无一例外**都属必需的说法缺乏细腻分辨，也抹去了（作者的）意图；他们恰当地主张，对某些人而言或许是束缚的东西，对另一些人而言则是自我塑造的自主实践。§§§in- 否定 + variable 可变的 → invariable → invariably§§§

30621§kinetic§kɪˈnetɪk§adj. 运动的；动力学的；动能的§… convert kinetic energy (resonance) to electrical energy …§……把**动能**（共振）转化为电能……§§§kine- 运动 + -tic§kinetic energy 动能（与 potential energy 势能相对）§§改译文：英文只是片段，原译多出英文没有的主语「压电采集器」

30622§candid§ˈkændɪd§adj. 坦率的；直言不讳的；（照片）抓拍的§Are you entirely happy, now that you are at home again? PROFESSOR RUBEK: No—to be quite candid—perhaps not entirely happy—MAIA: (With animation.) There, you see!§你现在回到家了，完全快乐吗？鲁贝克教授：不——**老实说**——也许并不完全快乐——玛雅：（兴奋地）你看！§§§§to be quite candid 老实说；candid photograph 抓拍照片§比 frank 更强调「不设防地坦白」§

30623§catalyst§ˈkætəlɪst§n. 催化剂；促进因素；促成变化的人或事§These devices are silicon-based solar cells coated in chemical catalysts that activate reactions that split water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen gas.§这些装置是硅基太阳能电池，表面覆有化学**催化剂**，可激活把水分子分解为氢气和氧气的反应。§§§§chemical catalysts 化学催化剂；a catalyst for change 变革的催化剂§§

30624§confederation§kənˌfedəˈreɪʃn§n. 邦联；联盟；同盟§Though the authorship of most of the essays is certain, that of some is obscure: for instance, while No. 15, "The Insufficiency of the Present Confederation to Preserve the Union," was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.§尽管大多数单篇论文的作者归属是确定的，少数几篇仍有疑问：例如第 15 篇《现行**邦联**不足以维系联邦》确为汉密尔顿所写，而第 62 篇《参议院》则可能出自汉密尔顿或麦迪逊之手。§A loose confederation of cities from eleven modern-day countries, the Hanseatic League was a powerful mercantile alliance that dominated northern European trade between the 13th and 17th centuries.§作为由今天十一个国家的城市组成的松散**联盟**，汉萨同盟是一个强大的商业联合体，在 13 至 17 世纪主导着北欧贸易。§§the present confederation 现行邦联；a loose confederation 松散的联盟§与 federation（联邦）不同：邦联的中央权力更弱§补译文2

30625§espouse§ɪˈspaʊz§v. 拥护；信奉；倡导（理念、事业、观点）§The Bauhaus was an influential German art and design school; the school famously espoused the design principle of "form follows function."§包豪斯是一所极具影响力的德国艺术设计学校，以**奉行**「形式追随功能」的设计原则而闻名。§Philosophers espousing presentism (the view that only present things exist) must contend with the truth-maker objection (TO).§**信奉**「现在主义」（认为只有当下存在之物才存在）的哲学家，必须直面「真值制造者」反驳（TO）。§拉丁 sponsare「订婚」（来自 spondere 承诺），经古法语 espouser 进入英语；spouse（配偶）同根§espousal n. 拥护；支持；近义 advocate、embrace 拥护§expound v. 阐述，拼形相近、意思不同§原书错：构词把古法语加在前面的 e- 当成拉丁「向」；说和 expound 只差一个字母，其实差好几个

30626§aspire§əˈspaɪə§v. 渴望；立志；追求（更高目标）§Miguel was an aspiring poet, and he had heard from his brother that the Ureña girls were none other than the daughters of Nicolás Ureña, and they were smart as clockwork.§米格尔是个**有志于**诗的年轻人，他从哥哥那里听说，乌雷尼亚家的姑娘们正是尼古拉斯·乌雷尼亚的女儿，而且她们聪明得像钟表一样精准。§The work aspires to be comprehensive by, for example, including accounts from cast and crew members of every Star Trek television series and film to date.§这部作品**力求**全面：例如收录了迄今每一部《星际迷航》剧集与电影的演职人员的讲述。§aspire to / after；名词 aspiration 志向；aspirational 向上流动的§an aspiring poet 有抱负的诗人；aspire to / after 渴望；追求§§

30627§elusive§iˈluːsɪv§adj. 难以找到的；难以捉摸的；难以实现的§Chorioactis geaster, a species of mushroom that makes a distinctive hissing sound when it releases its spores, is an elusive fungus that has been observed only in Texas and Oklahoma in the US and in the Miyazaki and Nara Prefectures in Japan.§Chorioactis geaster 是一种在释放孢子时会发出独特嘶嘶声的蘑菇，属**难以寻觅**的真菌，仅在美国得克萨斯与俄克拉何马，以及日本宫崎与奈良等地被观察到。§Although oil shocks have occurred multiple times since 1945, a broadly applicable description of how oil shocks affect economies has proved elusive, a problem typically attributed to the fact that oil shocks’ effects are substantially conditioned on country-specific characteristics (oil import-export ratios, most importantly).§尽管 1945 年以来石油危机已发生多次，但一个能广泛适用的「石油冲击如何影响经济」的描述却始终**难产**——问题通常被归因于：石油冲击的影响在很大程度上取决于各国具体特征（最重要的是石油进出口比）。§elude 躲避 → elusive§an elusive fungus 难觅的真菌；prove elusive 始终难以实现（得到）§与 illusive（虚幻的）易混§

30628§indelible§ɪnˈdeləbl§adj. 难以磨灭的；擦不掉的（印记、记忆）§Karel Čapek's 1920 play R.U.R. (Rossum's Universal Robots), in which artificial workers overthrow their masters, left an indelible mark on the science fiction genre, and the English language, by introducing the term "robot" (derived from the Czech word robota, meaning "indentured labor" or "drudgery").§卡雷尔·恰佩克 1920 年的剧作《罗素姆万能机器人》（剧中人造工人推翻了主人）给科幻类型乃至英语本身留下了一道**难以磨灭**的印记——它引入了「机器人」一词（源自捷克语 robota，意为「劳役」或「苦工」）。§§§in-（不）+ del（擦掉）+ -ible →「擦不掉的」，delete 同根§indelibly adv. 不可磨灭地；delete v. 删除；近义 permanent、enduring 持久的§§

30629§vortex§ˈvɔːteks§n. 漩涡；涡流；（比喻）漩涡般的处境§Liao showed that as vortex size increases, pressure fluctuations at the snout increase for narrow-headed and intermediate-headed fish but remain low for wide-headed fish.§Liao 表明，随着**涡旋**的尺寸增大，窄头鱼与中头鱼吻部的压力波动会加剧，而宽头鱼则始终维持在较低水平。§The Vortex is a 1924 satirical play by Noël Coward.§《**旋涡**》是诺埃尔·科沃德 1924 年的讽刺剧。§§vortex size 涡旋尺寸；复数 vortices§§改译文：「涡的尺寸」改为「涡旋的尺寸」，便于标出本词

30630§deter§dɪˈtɜː§v. 威慑；吓住；阻止§Their results suggest that poor street lighting can deter new or inexperienced cyclists from riding in a city but has little effect on experienced cyclists.§他们的研究结果表明，路灯照明不佳会使新手或缺乏经验的骑行者**不敢**在城市骑行，但对有经验的骑行者影响甚微。§§§§deter sb from doing 使某人不敢做；deterrent n. 威慑物§强调「吓阻」而非物理阻挡§删例句2：不含本词（deter mined 是 determined 断开，与 deter 无关）

30631§terrestrial§təˈrestriəl§adj. 陆地的；陆生的；地球的§In what is now southern Florida, the Calusa people (circa 1000–1600 CE) supported their relatively large population’s dietary needs with hydrological engineering rather than terrestrial farming methods.§在今天佛罗里达南部一带，卡卢萨人（约公元 1000–1600 年）依靠水利工程而非**陆地**农耕方式，满足了其相对众多人口的饮食需求。§Theropod dinosaurs, a diverse group of predators, ruled Earth's terrestrial ecosystem for over 160 million years, but their foraging ecology remains largely unknown.§兽脚类恐龙——种类繁多的捕食者——统治地球**陆地**生态系统逾 1.6 亿年，但其觅食生态仍基本未知。§§terrestrial farming 陆地农耕；terrestrial planets 类地行星§与 aquatic（水生的）、celestial（天上的）相对§

30632§innate§ɪˈneɪt§adj. 先天的；天生的；固有的§Modularity of mind is the notion that the mind is at least partly composed of innate neural structures (modules) that perform fast, necessary tasks.§心智模块论认为，心智至少部分由**先天**的神经结构（模块）构成，这些模块执行快速而必要的任务。§In their emphasis on the innate qualities of manufactured materials, both prints push traditional boundaries for figurative art.§两幅版画都强调制成材料的**固有**特质，从而推动了具象艺术的传统边界。§§innate neural structures 先天的神经结构；innate immunity 先天免疫§与 acquired（后天习得的）相对§

30633§anthology§ænˈθɒlədʒi§n. 选集；文集；（多位作者作品的）汇编§This divide is reflected in anthologies: a large majority of prose poems in such collections are under half a page, though The Penguin Book of the Prose Poem (2018) includes a high proportion of longer works.§这种分野在**选集**中有所体现：此类选本中的散文诗绝大多数不足半页，尽管《企鹅散文诗选集》（2018）收录了相当比例的长篇作品。§Editor Jared Shurin’s enormous 2023 anthology The Big Book of Cyberpunk comprises 108 stories.§Jared Shurin 主编的巨型**选集**《赛博朋克大书》（2023）收录了 108 篇小说。§antho- 花 + logy 收集 → anthology 原义「花环」§§§

30634§ecstasy§ˈekstəsi§n. 狂喜；入迷；忘我§My feelings seem to be those of our ancient earth in the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life; my own consciousness seems to stream through each blade of grass, each sucking root, to rise with the sap through the trees, to break out with joyous thrills in the waving fields of corn, in the rustling palm leaves.§我的感受仿佛就是古老大地在日日阳光抚照的生命中那份**狂喜**；我的意识似乎流过每一片草叶、每一条吸水的根须，随树液升上树梢，在起伏的玉米田与沙沙作响的棕榈叶间迸发出欢欣的颤栗。§§§§ecstatic adj. 欣喜若狂的§程度远强于 joy§

30635§myriad§ˈmɪriəd§n. 无数；大量 adj. 无数的；大量的§The land-breeze blows down through the pines, resinous, fragrant, cold, bringing breath-like memories of dim, dark woods shaded by myriad pine-needles.§陆风穿过松林吹来，带着松脂的气息，清冽而寒冷，唤起关于幽暗林地的朦胧记忆——那些林地被**无数**松针遮成一片阴翳。§It's a term created by British and Portuguese colonizers to refer to the myriad spiced sauces with ties to the Indian subcontinent.§该词由英国和葡萄牙殖民者创造，用来指称与印度次大陆有渊源的**无数**香辣酱料。§§a myriad of 无数的；大量的；myriad + 复数名词 无数的…§可作名词（a myriad of）或形容词（myriad + 复数名词）§

30636§coincide§ˌkəʊɪnˈsaɪd§v. 同时发生；（时间、空间）重合；（意见、利益）一致§The motif was subsequently reproduced multiple times at the site over the next 3,000 years, a period coinciding with extremely arid conditions and slightly negative population growth.§此后的 3,000 年里，这一母题在该遗址被反复重现——这段时期恰与极度干旱的气候条件以及略微负增长的人口相**重合**。§§§§coincide with 与…同时发生；与…一致；coincidence n. 巧合§§

30637§folklore§ˈfəʊklɔː§n. 民间传说；民俗§This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name is Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Turkey.§这一风格对世界各地的作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括奥尔罕·帕慕克：他 2001 年的小说《我的名字叫红》把文学现实主义与**民间传说**（即土耳其的民间传说）并置，颇似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。§§§folk 民众 + lore 传说学问；folkloric 民俗的§§§

30638§astronomical§ˌæstrəˈnɒmɪkl§adj. 天文的；天文学的；（数字）天文数字般的；极大的§As Morales-Aguilar et al. have shown, developments at those earlier Mirador sites (e.g., the eight astronomically aligned complexes at El Mirador) were a historical precondition for the sophistication exhibited by the architects of later cities.§正如 Morales-Aguilar 等人所表明，米拉多尔早期遗址的那些建设（例如埃尔米拉多尔八处按**天文**方位排列的建筑群）是后来的城市建设者得以展现其精巧技艺的历史前提。§Minor planets are astronomical objects that orbit the Sun but are neither planets nor comets.§小行星是绕太阳运行、既非行星亦非彗星的**天体**。§§astronomically aligned 按天文方位排列的；astronomical objects 天体§§改例句：例句2 末尾多一个句点

30639§resilient§rɪˈzɪliənt§adj. 有弹性的；有韧性的；能迅速恢复的§Although the increase in widgeon grass has been associated with a substantial increase in total seagrass coverage in the bay, researchers caution that the latter change does not necessarily make the seagrass ecosystem as a whole more resilient to environmental shocks.§尽管宽叶眼子菜的增多与该湾海草总覆盖面积的大幅上升有关，研究者提醒，后一变化并不必然使整个海草生态系统对环境冲击更**具韧性**。§§§re- 回 + silire 跳 → resilient；名词 resilience 韧性§resilient to 对…有韧性§§

30642§brink§brɪŋk§n. （悬崖、河岸等的）边缘；边沿；（引申）濒临§The speaker is looking at the reflections of plants in a river. The little fern-leaf, bending Upon the brink, its green reflection greets, And kisses soft the shadow that it meets With touch so fine, The border line The keenest vision can’t define; So perfect is the blending.§说话者正在看河中植物的倒影。那片小小的蕨叶在**岸边**弯垂，它碧绿的倒影前来相迎，以极轻柔的触碰吻上所遇的影子；那交界之线，最锐利的目光也无法分辨——融合得如此完美。§Pauline Johnson’s 2002 poem “Shadow Lake.” The little fern-leaf, bending Upon the brink, its green reflection greets, And kisses soft the shadow that it meets With touch so fine, The border line The keenest vision can’t define; So perfect is the blending.§Pauline Johnson 2002 年的诗作《影湖》。小小的蕨叶，俯身在**岸边**，迎接它绿色的倒影，轻柔地吻着它所遇见的影子——那触碰如此细微，那分界线连最锐利的目光也无法分辨；那融合是如此完美。§§on the brink of 濒临（崩溃、战争等）；bending upon the brink 在岸边弯垂§§改例句：诗行合并处漏空格（greets,And 等），例句2 同改；改译文：漏译开头一句 The speaker is looking at the reflections of plants in a river

30644§expressive§ɪkˈspresɪv§adj. 富于表现力的；表达（情感）的；表现的§Techniques of positive expressive writing include one called "three good things," which involves writing down three good things that happen each day, and "resource diary," which involves writing about the resources one has available.§积极的**表达性**写作技法中，有一种叫「三件好事」，即写下每天发生的三件好事；还有一种叫「资源日记」，即写下自己可支配的各种资源。§§§express 表达 → expressive；名词 expressiveness 表现力§expressive writing 表达性写作§§删例句2：不含本词（expressions 是 expression，不是 expressive 的派生）；删搭配：原搭配说明「expression — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数」不是搭配

30645§mediocre§ˌmiːdiˈəʊkə§adj. 平庸的；平凡的；中等的§Isaac Asimov, author of The Caves of Steel and The Stars, Like Dust, is highly regarded despite his mediocre writing style.§艾萨克·阿西莫夫是《钢穴》与《星辰，如尘埃》的作者，尽管文风**平庸**，却备受推崇。§§§§a mediocre writing style 平庸的文风§贬义偏强，含「本可以更好却只是将就」的意味§

30646§alleviate§əˈliːvieɪt§v. 减轻；缓解（痛苦、问题）§Many experts, like lawyer and cycling advocate Ernesto Hernandez-Lopez, have proposed bike travel as one possible way to alleviate congestion on the busy roadways of Los Angeles County California.§许多专家——如律师兼骑行倡导者 Ernesto Hernandez-Lopez——提出，自行车出行是**缓解**加州洛杉矶县繁忙道路拥堵的一种可行方式。§Hincapié found that one impediment is lack of knowledge about the practical details of how businesses are started; he further found that simply providing young adults with good informational resources on the topic significantly alleviates this problem.§Hincapié 发现一个障碍是缺乏「企业如何创办」的实操细节知识；他进一步发现，只需为年轻人提供这方面优质的信息资源，就能显著**缓解**这一问题。§§alleviate congestion 缓解拥堵§只减轻不消除；与 mitigate 近义，alleviate 更常搭配 pain / congestion§改例句：例句2 末尾带不可见的零宽字符，删去

30647§endowment§ɪnˈdaʊmənt§n. 捐赠基金；捐款；天赋；禀赋§While US public charities, like Habitat for Humanity International, must file Form 990 yearly with the IRS, private foundations, such as Lilly Endowment Inc., must file a different form, 990-PF.§美国的公共慈善机构（如仁人家园国际）须每年向国税局提交 990 表，而私人**基金会**（如礼来基金会）则须提交另一种表格 990-PF。§§§§Lilly Endowment Inc. 礼来基金会；natural endowment 天赋；endow v. 捐赠；赋予§§

30648§invalidate§ɪnˈvælɪdeɪt§v. 使无效；使作废；推翻（既有结论或归类）§It is, by itself, sufficient to invalidate how the basking shark has been categorized in the past.§仅凭这一证据本身，就足以**推翻**姥鲨以往被归入的分类方式。§It has been largely invalidated by results obtained from similar studies.§该结论已在很大程度上被同类研究得出的结果**推翻**。§in-（否定）+ valid（有效的）+ -ate（动词后缀）；反义词 validate 使生效、证实§be invalidated by 被…推翻；invalid adj. 无效的（an invalid argument 无效的论证）；invalid n. 病弱者（重音前移 ˈɪnvəlɪd）§研究类篇章里 ≈ overturn / refute，指推翻既有结论或归类§改译文：删去夹在译文里的英文（invalidate）

30649§suspense§səˈspens§n. 悬念；悬而未决；（等待结果的）焦虑§Clancy of the Mounted is a 1933 serial that, over its 12 episodes, kept its audience interested with the suspense and drama that are typical of the northern adventure genre.§《Clancy of the Mounted》是 1933 年的一部系列片，在十二集里以北方冒险类型惯有的**悬念**与戏剧张力维持观众的兴趣。§Every installment ended with a moment of unresolved suspense.§每一集结尾都留下一刻悬而未决的**悬念**。§suspend 悬置 → suspense；形容词 suspenseful§the suspense and drama 悬念与戏剧性；unresolved suspense 悬而未决的悬念§§改例句：例句2 句末多一个句点

30650§sentimental§ˌsentɪˈmentl§adj. 感伤的；多愁善感的；情感上的§In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom praises the novel's adroit blend of what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big demonstrates that a work can be both.§在为克劳利《Little, Big》所写的后记中，布鲁姆称赞这部小说巧妙融合了剧作家席勒所称的「素朴」与「**感伤**」两种模式——席勒认为作品或属素朴（力求描摹现实），或属感伤（力求发展理念），而《Little, Big》证明一部作品可以两者兼具。§§§§the sentimental mode 感伤模式§席勒美学中与 naive（素朴的）相对：一个描摹现实，一个追寻理想§
